nodes.label: Sound and speech rules (frontend/app.js)
nodes.rationale: Taps, ticks and what Pip says are not in the design; they follow research-based rules in frontend/app.js.

nodes.label: index.html (Pip screen markup and styles)
nodes.rationale: Built from the pen.dev design; colors, font and labels must match design/tokens.json. All screens are sections in one page; ui.js decides which one shows.

nodes.label: project.yml (XcodeGen spec for the Pip iOS app)
nodes.norm_label: project.yml (xcodegen spec for the pip ios app)

nodes.label: Pip iOS app target (com.ycgsf.pip, iOS 17)
nodes.rationale: Builds Swift sources in Pip/ and copies ../frontend as a folder resource so the native app shows the web screen; iPhone-only, portrait-only.

nodes.label: tools/check_design.py design check
nodes.rationale: Run after any UI change; must print 'matches', then compare an app screenshot with the design frame.

nodes.label: Design tokens (design/tokens.json)
nodes.rationale: Code uses only the design's colors and font as CSS variables with the same names (--bg, --fg, --accent...). Readable copy re-exported from pen.dev whenever the design changes; also holds frame ids and fixed labels. graphify skips this file because 'tokens' looks like a secret.

nodes.label: ycgsf repo (../ycgsf-pip: model server, trips, trip tools)
nodes.norm_label: ycgsf repo (../ycgsf-pip: model server, trips, trip tools)

nodes.label: Info.plist privacy usage descriptions (camera, mic, motion, location, local network)
nodes.norm_label: info.plist privacy usage descriptions (camera, mic, motion, location, local network)
nodes.rationale: Camera finds doors, rooms and objects; mic lets you talk to Pip; motion measures turns and steps; GPS only for outdoor trips; local network reaches the model server.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md (Pip project instructions)
nodes.rationale: Repo holds Pip's app: frontend/ (screen and app logic), ios/ (iPhone app that shows frontend/), design/ (pen.dev design, tokens, shaders) and tools/ (design check, shader export). Model server and trip tools live in the separate ycgsf repo.

nodes.label: Cleanup contract
nodes.rationale: Delete what Claude made once it is replaced and unused, in the same task; never delete user/other-session work, trips/ recordings or git history without asking; report deletions.

nodes.label: Design-first rule
nodes.rationale: Any change to what Pip's screen shows (label, button, status line, color) goes into the pen.dev design before the code.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge-graph contract
nodes.rationale: Query graphify-out/ before reading or grepping code; run 'graphify update .' after code changes and '/graphify --update' after doc changes; large graph.json diffs are expected.

nodes.label: pen.dev design contract
nodes.rationale: design/untitled.pen is the single source of truth for how Pip looks; .pen files are encrypted so they are read and edited only through the pen.dev MCP tools, never Read/Grep.

nodes.label: Testing contract: Mac vs phone
nodes.rationale: Screens, animations, builds, speech and server replies are tested on the Mac; pathfinding, guiding, GPS walks, ARKit/LiDAR tracking and camera finding need a person walking, so no simulated walks: the user tests on the phone and the trip recording is pulled for diagnosis.

nodes.label: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads (App Transport Security off)
nodes.rationale: Lets the app talk plain HTTP to the model server on the local network.

nodes.label: 05 Setup screen (#scr-setup)
nodes.rationale: Rows for headphones flipped, listen mode, camera, models, server address and voice (Kokoro with on-device fallback); footer says 'Prototype. Not a mobility aid.'
